name: directory
title: Diocese of Metuchen parish finder
command: pnpm diocese roster import metuchen directory scratch/metuchen-map-1/001-survey/directory2.json
notes: eCatholic parish-finder map, read 2026-10-30 with parish-site-access finder.py (behind Cloudflare: probe url gets 403). 91 pins = 90 parish entries (St. Elizabeth-St. Brigid has one pin per worship site, 24487 and 25192). Pins are the parish office or main church. Extra fields from the rendered finder HTML (tools/finder_details.py): deanery (8 deaneries), clergy (pastor/administrator line), finder_detail (the Details tab) and mass_locations (church names in the Sunday Mass notes). Lags on mergers: still lists St. Joseph and St. Luke, North Plainfield separately, merged 2025-07-01 as Sts. Joseph and Luke. A stray space in the Spotswood website was removed.
